title: Final Frequency Expression
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly express the measured frequency nu' in terms of the proper frequency nu.

title: Final Angle Calculation
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly calculate the angle of observation theta' in the K' frame.

title: Use of Lorentz Factor
description: Important Criteria: The student should correctly apply the Lorentz factor gamma in the frequency transformation.

title: Correct Angle Usage
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly use the angle theta in the calculations for both frequency and angle transformations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid sign mistakes in the application of the Doppler effect equations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student must ensure that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.
